name: Slideshow I
description: Future Crew's slideshow of nine VGA pictures, with four-channel Sound Blaster music
author: Future Crew

ready.stdout: 9 - Sound Blaster with 12Mhz or faster AT.

start.note: DosKit picks the Sound Blaster in its sound menu. Press Space once a picture has faded in for the next one.

hint: Slideshow I waits at its sound menu: press 9 for the Sound Blaster. Then press Space once a picture has faded in for the next one.
